newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat European sales rise in February.
newsitem.headline: Fiat European sales rise in February.

text.p: Fiat Auto sales in Europe rose 4.9 percent in February year-on-year in a market which fell one percent overall, giving Fiat a market share of 13.2 percent against 12.5 percent in February 1996, a car sector source said.
Fiat confirmed its second place ranking among European manufacturers behind Germany's Volkswagen.
The Fiat Punto continued to be the Turin maker's best seller in February with 53,000 units sold and orders for over two million so far placed with dealers.

Orders for the Marea, Fiat's latest medium-to-large model which was launched in September, have reached some 100,000 while orders for the Lancia Y which started to be sold a year ago have reached 140,000.
